evals.prompt: Review the geometry for a rounded document panel: border-box outer radius 32px, 1px border, 11px padding, child margin 0. Specify the child outer radius and its inner radius if it has a 2px border. Show CSS custom properties that stay correct if padding changes. Explain the derivation.
evals.expected_output: 20px child outer, 18px child inner; tokens derive from border plus padding.

evals.prompt: Review a composer with outer corner radius 28px, 1px border, 11px padding and a 44px circular send button aligned at its bottom right. Are the corners concentric? Propose a coherent adjustment while retaining a 44px hit target. Also explain a 12px radius card with 16px inner inset and a pill declared with radius 9999px at height 40px.
evals.expected_output: Circle center mismatch, 34px outer radius or alternative deliberate geometry; inner clamp zero; pill used radius 20px.
